name: Cragspire Falls
description: A mountain stream drops over a cliff into a deep pool. Trout and grayling hold in the cold water, and at dawn and dusk the salmon leap the falls.

discovery.message: Above the roar of the wind you hear falling water, and find a stream thundering down into a pool below the path.

falls.text: The falls thunder into a deep green pool. Spray hangs in the air. On a ledge beside the pool, smoke rises from a small camp.

pool.text: Trout hold in the slack water at the pool's edges, and when the light is low, salmon hurl themselves at the falls.

camp.text: A huge red-bearded man sits by the fire, turning a salmon on a stick. He looks at your rod and grins.

leave.text: You leave the roar of the falls behind.
